$schema_note: FCCPC-registered digital money lender (DML) universe -- source #9 in docs/loan-database-plan.md. This is the broad universe of licensed digital lending apps/companies, distinct from institutions.json (which covers CBN-licensed banks/MFBs). Overlap exists (e.g. an MFB may also appear here if it runs an app), not yet cross-referenced to institution_id.
coverage_note: Full and conditional approval categories only (559 entries), fetched directly from FCCPC's own published tables (fccpc.gov.ng/approvals-of-dmls/ and fccpc.gov.ng/registration-of-digital-money-lenders/), list dated 2026-03-03 per the page's own metadata. FCCPC also maintains Watchlist, Delisted, Airtime/Data Lender, and CBN-waiver categories that were not extracted in this pass -- treat this file as 'approved lenders' only, not the full regulatory picture.
